posts.text: George Ogilvie, incoming President and Chief Executive Officer, commented: "The Hercules assets in Idaho have the potential to be an exceptionally large copper porphyry system in the United States that offers size and scale on a regional level. Our team is delighted and grateful to the existing Hercules management team and Board for this opportunity to join what is developing to be one of the most exciting copper exploration stories in the United States.
